subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar merge an internally selectable authoritative lineage mode now, or keep lineage shadow-only until promotion evidence is mechanically enforced and validated on this exact head?
rationale: The code introduces a new accounting source of truth and policy knob whose acceptance threshold, rollout timing, and residual-error tolerance require explicit product ownership beyond ordinary correctness review.

options.title: Keep lineage shadow-only
options.body: Remove or make authoritative lineage selection unreachable until a successful evaluator decision is required by the selector and exact-head rollout proof is available.

options.title: Accept an advisory promotion gate
options.body: Merge the selectable lineage authority with the evaluator remaining advisory, explicitly accepting that internal callers can bypass the documented evidence policy.

recommendation.title: Keep lineage shadow-only
recommendation.body: Remove or make authoritative lineage selection unreachable until a successful evaluator decision is required by the selector and exact-head rollout proof is available.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent scanner changes and merge decisions place this person closest to the accounting rollout and compatibility boundary.
